scope: Settings/layout persistence software reliability; user explicitly defers hardware

source_contract.ownership: product_settings_store.c owns the single wf_store worker, request generations, deadlines and results; product_services.c keeps FlashDB adapters and startup restore
source_contract.format: Preferences v6/24 bytes and existing legacy decoding unchanged; layout A/B format/readback unchanged; no alarm storage change or new power-loss guarantee
source_contract.scheduling: Preferences debounce 1500ms, layout immediate; each request at most three attempts, 5000ms after a failed attempt completes; no pending job means event wait forever
source_contract.retry: Same pending/done preference value reuses ID; new content or explicit failed-value retry obtains new ID/budget. Failed terminal state does not autonomously retry
source_contract.concurrency: Short request mutex, I/O outside it; stale completions cannot change newer status. Failed/partial preference writes invalidate old persisted shadow, including superseded attempts
source_contract.success: Preferences write plus exact length/readback/memcmp/decode equality required; layout uses existing write/readback commit. I/O holds IDLE only during an attempt
source_contract.ui: Product pumps settings at existing 250ms collection and before screen-off. Pending/saved/failed note reuses settings_note, failed note and existing layout overlay are clickable retry. Terminal states stop status queries
source_contract.truthfulness: No backend means no fictional saved hint; request rejection is failed. Failure keeps in-memory choices. No automatic display wake on background completion. No new XML/generated/font assets
